description: An Excel-like spreadsheet component for viewing and editing tabular data. Supports cell editing, formulas, styling, multi-sheet workbooks, and XLSX import/export.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: XLSX file data to load into the spreadsheet.

parameters.name: InitialWorkbook
parameters.description: Pre-populates the spreadsheet with an existing workbook on first render. Subsequent parameter changes are ignored — read the Workbook property to get the current state after editing.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Controls the display and interaction mode of the spreadsheet. Defaults to Full.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The CSS height of the spreadsheet container. Defaults to 600px.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The CSS width of the spreadsheet container. Defaults to 100%.

parameters.name: RowsCount
parameters.description: The initial number of rows to render. Defaults to 200.

parameters.name: ColumnsCount
parameters.description: The initial number of columns to render. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: RowHeight
parameters.description: The default row height in pixels. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: ColumnWidth
parameters.description: The default column width in pixels. Defaults to 64.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the root element.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Additional HTML attributes splatted onto the root element.

parameters.name: OnOpen
parameters.description: Called when a file is opened/imported.

parameters.name: OnDownload
parameters.description: Called when the workbook is downloaded/exported.

parameters.name: OnChange
parameters.description: Called when any cell value or formula changes.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Called when the active cell or selection changes.

parameters.name: OnCellEdit
parameters.description: Called when a cell enters or exits edit mode.

publicMethods.name: Workbook
publicMethods.description: Gets the underlying workbook for programmatic access.

publicMethods.name: SetCellValue
publicMethods.description: Sets the value of a cell on the active sheet, e.g. SetCellValue("A1", 42).

publicMethods.name: ExportToExcelAsync
publicMethods.description: Serialises the current workbook to XLSX bytes.

publicMethods.name: ImportFromExcelAsync
publicMethods.description: Replaces the current workbook with the contents of the supplied XLSX bytes.

publicMethods.name: FocusGridAsync
publicMethods.description: Moves keyboard focus to the grid.

examples.title: Basic spreadsheet
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet Height="500px"
               RowsCount="100"
               ColumnsCount="20"
               OnChange="HandleChange" />

@code {
    private void HandleChange(SpreadsheetChangeEventArgs args)
        => Console.WriteLine($"{args.CellRef} = {args.NewValue}");
}

examples.title: Load and export an XLSX workbook
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet @ref="_sheet" Data="@_xlsxBytes" />

<TmButton OnClick="DownloadAsync">Download</TmButton>

@code {
    private TmSpreadsheet? _sheet;
    private byte[]? _xlsxBytes;

    private async Task DownloadAsync()
    {
        var bytes = await _sheet!.ExportToExcelAsync();
        // hand the bytes to your download helper
    }
}

examples.title: Read-only view and programmatic edits
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet @ref="_sheet" Mode="SpreadsheetMode.Full" />

@code {
    private TmSpreadsheet? _sheet;

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender) return;
        _sheet!.SetCellValue("A1", "Total");
        _sheet.SetCellValue("B1", "=SUM(B2:B10)");
    }
}
